Your order note puts this block right before Rollover so target and pace connect to what moves them, so this is the line that sets Rollover up: next block, the pace moves and the target stays where it was. cur: A week that comes up short can feel like failing, and that feeling makes users less likely to keep going. So nobody has to decide what to do with it while they’re already behind: an unfinished Action Item moves into the next week on its own. An earlier version asked users to choose at that moment, with the math on screen, and we cut it because it felt like a gate, not a guide. A week can only hold the hours the user set aside for it (their capacity). The Rollover takes up some of the next week’s capacity, so some of that week’s Action Items move to the week after, and the ones behind them move along too. That is why the pace date moves later, and since the journey pace is the last Pathway’s pace, the journey moves with it. The target stays where it was.
